title: dryopteris affinis var. paleaceolobata
intro: Dryopteris affinis var. paleaceolobata, commonly known as the golden hay-scented fern, is a variety of the Dryopteris affinis species, a type of fern native to Europe. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dryopteris affinis var. paleaceolobata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties.
